completion:
Prepare an additional page for each failed building-firesafety check.
3. Head this sheet "failed fire-safety checks - Days name address building report number".
4. For each failed item
    a. Identify the landing, floor or common area being inspected.
    b. Write down the fire-safety check number and description from the proforma.
    c. Describe in your own words the nature and significance of the defect found, and how it affects fire safety (this would normally be inferred from the description of the check).
    d. Say where the order is already in force.
    e. If a notice is still outstanding, say which one it is, and the date of service and any other note on progress.
